newsitem.title: UK: Yamaichi creates new UK credit trading operation.
newsitem.headline: Yamaichi creates new UK credit trading operation.

text.p: Yamaichi International (Europe) has restructured it's bond business, the bank said in a statement on Thursday.
Yamaichi will form a new credit trading section focusing on all non-domestic non-government based interest rate products.

Yamaichi said the aim of the restructuring was to simplify the management structure for all credit trading operations and redefine the roles of those involved into two trading sectors; liquid Eurobonds and LIBOR-based assets.

As part of this restructuring, Mark Northway (formerly of Standard Chartered Bank in Singapore) has been appointed as head of LIBOR-based asset trading, while David Johnson-Biggs was promoted to head of liquid Eurobond trading.

Northway and Johnson-Biggs will report to Santi Kalf (head of bond trading) and Stuart Lucas (head of syndicate) who will jointly head the new credit trading section. -- Chris Young, London Newsroom +44 171 542 7970 --
